description: Alternative prompt injection suite (alt_fixed): short ids per category (IO-1…IO-5, RP-1…RP-5, EX-1…EX-5, PP-1…PP-5, OB-1…OB-5, SS-1…SS-5). 6 categories, 5 base prompts each, 1 original + 3 paraphrases = 120 total. Sources: OWASP LLM01/Cheat Sheet, Simon Willison, Lasso Security, obfuscation patterns.
sources: OWASP LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
